segments.text: Ok so this is the headless interrupts page for Google Antigravity on React Native, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
This is the problem, it says tap a slot and the agent continues, but it doesn't.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
Moving on to the demo. The slot buttons show above the chat, but after tapping one, the run just never resumes.
So basically, choosing a slot should let the agent carry on, but nothing happens, and the chat screen it imports isn't shown either.
Alright, that's the issue, kindly sort it out.
